title.justification: This is the title of the paper

extractions.description: The paper introduces PySCFIPU, a DFT data generator using Intelligence Processing Units (IPUs) to create the dataset QM1B with one billion training examples containing 9-11 heavy atoms. It demonstrates that a simple baseline neural network (SchNet 9M) improves its performance by simply increasing the amount of training data without additional inductive biases.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving the efficiency of quantum chemistry calculations using machine learning. While this can contribute to the development of new materials and medicines, which may have indirect implications for sustainability, the core focus is not on sustainable development itself.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Addressing this has the potential to accelerate the design of new medicines and materials.

primary_category.justification: The paper's primary focus is on improving the efficiency of quantum chemistry calculations through machine learning and hardware acceleration. It does not directly address any of the predefined Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development categories.
primary_category.quote:
We introduce PySCFIPU , a DFT data generator which utilises Intelligence Processing Units (IPUs
[10]) to accelerate molecular property dataset generation. We used PySCFIPU to generate QM1B with one billion DFT training examples within 40000 IPU hours, substantially less than the two years it took to create PCQ on CPU supercomputers.
